开启后，应用向 Magisk 请求 Root，仍需你在实例内点击允许。授权、模块:
Apps request root from Magisk; you still authorize each app inside the instance. Authorizations, modules and Zygisk settings are independent.
Install module ZIP files in Magisk and enable Zygisk in its settings. Then return to IrisBox and stop and start this instance.
If a module prevents startup, stop the instance and enable rescue startup. It disables modules and Zygisk while preserving apps, accounts and module files so you can repair them in Magisk. Disable rescue afterwards.
Turning root off preserves records; resetting data erases them. Firmware flashing and global kernel/SELinux changes are unsupported.

Apps request Root through Magisk and still require your approval inside the instance. Authorizations, modules and Zygisk settings are separate for each instance.
Install module ZIPs on the Magisk Modules page; enable Zygisk in Magisk settings. Then return to IrisBox, stop and start this instance.
If a module prevents booting, stop the instance and enable Rescue boot. This disables modules and Zygisk while preserving apps, accounts and module files for repair. Disable rescue after repair, then re-enable components as needed.
Turning Root off preserves records. Resetting data clears them. Flashing upgrades and global kernel/SELinux changes are unsupported.
